head: bcaf7a2538a10176c89dd1fddddafbe29826b56e
scope: Settings durability contract through MockBackend JSON-RPC, joined manager restart and browser status
assertions: RPC Apply is distinct from durable save; failed write preserves existing bytes
Writer pending/error visible through RPC, separate from LCD error
Retry without new Apply clears error and persists intent
Joined shutdown preserves independent settings; new manager on renumbered mock path replays applied brightness and rotation
Failed final flush retains pending/error and old durable file, next manager replays old configuration
Browser pending/error takes priority over historical saved flag; draft retained; retry sends no second mutation
limits: Injected failure is a directory at the temporary-file path; not ENOSPC/fsync/rename fault or power loss
Memory JSON-RPC transport and MockBackend, not physical USB
Browser IPC is mocked; native disk-fault flow not run
Existing Vite development raw font-license import warning remains
